Game Overview

Bad Timing is a action game built around navigate a gripping zombie world where every decision is life or death. With limited resources and increasing threats, precision and strategy are key to surviving relentless zombie waves. Explore for vital supplies, master resource management, and outwit the hordes in a dynamic, ever-challenging environment.
